abstract: We analyzed five cases of pure dysgerminoma following the same schedule for the treatment, which were studied during the period of 1971 to 1983. The age of patients during the period of histological examination ranged from 15 years and 6 months to 28 years. All five patients had already had their "first menstruation". The above cases examined according to the clinical findings, the symptoms, the stage of the disease; the sort of treatment the place, the period and kind of therapy in case of reappearance of the disease and final survival.
abstract_ja: 1971年から1983年までに同一の治療スケジュールで治療された純粋型ディスジャーミノーマ5例を解析した。組織学的診断時の患者年齢は15歳6か月から28歳であった。5例全例がすでに初経を迎えていた。以上の症例は、臨床所見、症状、病期、治療の種類、施行場所と期間、再発時の治療の種類、および最終的な生存に従って検討された。
